operations.title: Nima corrects the weight-five logarithmic support contract to 26 plus 5
operations.body: Support refinement for the exactness matrix (event 1287): the descended rational form has 26 marked norm poles, but ∇_12345 adds five branch divisors R_i=0. The complete logarithmic support packet is therefore 31 labelled components (fiberwise, q_G is parameter-only), not just the 26 norms. The five additions are existing edge-soft/Kummer supports, not new marked carrier divisors.
